req.title: Login sets session on success
req.statement: The system shall set session['user_id'] and redirect to / when POST /auth/login receives a matching username and password.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-008 requires that POST /auth/login with valid credentials returns HTTP 302 to '/' and sets session['user_id']. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid username+password yields 302 and correct session cookie; (2) negative NEG — wrong password yields no redirect and no session mutation; (3) boundary BVA — non-existent username yields no session; (4) DT — correct username but wrong password (decision table branch); (5) STC — session state transition from anonymous to authenticated. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_login_success_sets_session_and_redirects
preconditions: Database contains user id=1 username='Rahul' password='stone'
App is in TESTING mode with a fresh temp database
actions: Inspect response status code and Location header
Open session context to verify session['user_id']
trace: R-FLASKR-008: session cookie set with user_id
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client:
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/', f'Expected /, got {r.headers["Location"]}'
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess, 'session["user_id"] not set'
        assert sess['user_id'] == 1, f'Expected user_id=1, got {sess["user_id"]}'

os.unlink(path)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client:
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'wrongpassword'})
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Expected 200, got {r.status_code}'

tests.name: test_login_state_transition_anonymous_to_authenticated
preconditions: Client starts with no session (anonymous state)
Database contains user id=5 username='James' password='river'
actions: Verify session has no user_id before login
Verify session now has user_id == 5 (authenticated state)
trace: R-FLASKR-008: STC — anonymous -> authenticated state transition via successful login
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client:
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' not in sess, 'Pre-condition: session must be anonymous'

    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'James', 'password': 'river'})
    assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/', f'Expected /, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'

    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess, 'Post-login: session["user_id"] must be set'
        assert sess['user_id'] == 5, f'Expected user_id=5, got {sess["user_id"]}'

os.unlink(path)

tests.name: test_login_session_cleared_before_setting_user_id
preconditions: Client has a stale session with a different user_id set manually
Database contains user id=3 username='Ishaan' password='stone'
actions: Verify session['user_id'] is now exactly 3 (not 99, not absent)
trace: R-FLASKR-008: STC boundary — session.clear() then session['user_id']=user['id'] replaces stale session
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app
from flaskr.db import get_db, init_db

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

with client:
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess['user_id'] = 99

    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Ishaan', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302, f'Expected 302, got {r.status_code}'
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/', f'Expected /, got {r.headers.get("Location")}'

    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        assert 'user_id' in sess, 'session["user_id"] must be set after login'
        assert sess['user_id'] == 3, f'Expected user_id=3, got {sess["user_id"]}'

os.unlink(path)
